plugins.name: ux-ui-mastery
plugins.description: The definitive UX/UI design mastery plugin — 21 skills, 65+ references, 20 commands, 380K+ words. Action-packed commands like /taste (sector style direction), /vibe-check (UX audit), /ship (component builder), /roast (design critique), /screen (screen builder), /inspo (inspiration finder), and 14 more. Cognitive psychology, production code (React/SwiftUI/CSS), Figma MCP design-to-code, NNG heuristics, case studies, sector-specific style intelligence, and 2025-2026 cutting-edge research.
